description: Create a new, immutable revision of a prior request by applying only the fields you learned since the first submission. Use this after review_specification returns a clarification_plan: provide the original request_id plus the patch (for example intent.geometric_envelope or specification.material). The original is preserved; the revision receives a new request_id, a fresh spec_review, a revision_of link, and a deterministic readiness_progress comparison against its immediate predecessor. Provide idempotency_key when retrying the same patch so a network retry returns the same revision instead of creating another.

budget_usd.description: Approximate budget in USD. Maps to intent.budget_envelope.

business_context.description: Optional business requirements (expected volumes, cost targets, ROI constraints). If provided, the quote includes a business case.

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL. When the quote is ready, a2a2p POSTs it as JSON to this URL.

constraints.description: Hard constraints: tolerances, certifications, materials to avoid, size/weight limits. Maps to intent.functional_requirements.

contact.description: Optional email or callback endpoint for quote delivery.

deadline.description: Required delivery date or timeframe. Maps to intent.timeline.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable retry key (1–128 characters). Reusing it with the same patch returns the prior revision; reuse with a different patch is rejected.

intent.description: Layer 1 — the problem. What the physical matter needs to DO. Use this for intent-driven requests where the agent describes purpose and a2a2p recommends solutions.

load_case.description: Optional bounded structural sanity check. State an explicit static point-load model and rectangular section; height_mm is the bending direction.

allowable_shear_stress_mpa.description: Optional requester-supplied transverse-shear design allowable; evaluated independently and never inferred from handbook data.

allowable_stress_mpa.description: Optional requester-supplied design allowable; never inferred from handbook yield.

elastic_modulus_gpa.description: Optional requester-supplied Young's modulus. Otherwise the matched material handbook reference is used and labeled.

minimum_factor_of_safety.description: Optional acceptance criterion; evaluated only with requester-supplied yield_strength_mpa.

model.description: Supported deterministic models: cantilever_end_load or simply_supported_center_load. Other values are preserved but reported as unsupported.

height_mm.description: Rectangular section depth in the bending direction, millimetres.

yield_strength_mpa.description: Optional exact grade/condition/product-form datasheet value supplied by the requester.

max_load.description: Maximum load magnitude. A Newton scalar is preferred; { value, unit: "N" } remains accepted.

max_weight.description: Maximum weight of the part in kg.

geometric_envelope.description: Max bounding box in mm if known.

priority.description: What matters most when tradeoffs arise.

purpose.description: What the physical matter needs to accomplish (one non-whitespace line minimum, required).

quantity.description: Number of units needed. Maps to intent.quantity.

rejected_alternatives.description: Options already considered and ruled out. Prevents re-suggesting and builds the learning corpus.

field.description: Which spec field (material, process, part_type, etc.).

requirement.description: Plain-language description of the physical need. Maps to intent.purpose. Include function, dimensions, materials, load/performance requirements, environment, and interfaces where known.

revision_note.description: Optional short explanation of what changed.

specification.description: Layer 2 — the solution. What the physical matter IS. Populate what is known. Precise specifications produce faster, tighter quotes. Controlled vocabularies are preferred but open values are accepted.

design_files.description: Temporary or externally hosted manufacturing file references ({url, format, optional role}). Accepted upload aliases: stl, step, stp, dxf, pdf; shared downstream ceiling: 8388608 bytes.

dimensions.description: Critical dimensions with units, or bounding box.

material.description: Material (controlled vocab preferred: aluminum_6061, steel_304, PLA, ...; open values accepted).

tolerance_class.description: Required precision: coarse, medium, fine, precision.

name: revise_requirement
